caption: The drawing depicts a vintage baby carriage with a structure composed primarily of red and brown elements. It features four large, spoked wheels in red, with the front and rear wheels of similar size. The body of the carriage has an ornate, reddish-brown frame, which supports an upholstered green seat with a matching green backrest and armrests. Above the seat, a canopy is supported by four thin upright rods, each with decorative circular elements halfway up. The canopy has a dark, almost black fabric on top, with multicolored fringes hanging from its edge—predominantly yellow, red, and green. Two long, slender, black handles extend from the back of the carriage, curving upward and outward. The entire drawing is enclosed within a thin red border, all placed on an off-white background.
title: Baby Carriage
